This prevented post-closeout verification from validating the repository after D4-A5 scientific closeout was frozen at c33f4cbe.

It now mechanically verifies the full 6-node lineage (R8 -> closeout -> raw-freeze -> R7 -> plan-freeze -> R6), closeout diff seal (only manifest, evaluator results, continuation result changed between raw-freeze and closeout), R8 repair diff seal (strictly within the 7 allowed files), scientific artifact blob seals (raw plans, raw results, closeout outputs unchanged), scientific implementation seals (runner and tests identical between R7 and closeout), historical per-stage baselines, production immutability, clean worktree/index seal, and machine-artifact consistency.
